guitar.modelsText: Fernandes Stratocaster copy "Blue" / Gibson Les Paul Junior
guitar.notes: Confirmed — Billie Joe Armstrong's battered Fernandes "Blue" guitar is extremely well documented as his main guitar for decades.

tone.target: nasal fuzzed-out garage punk riff with lo-fi sustain
tone.profile: nasal fuzzed-out garage punk riff with lo-fi sustain
tone.summary: A noisy, fuzzed signal chain using a Fuzz distortion pedal into a classic British amp model (UK 45) for a raw, garage-punk sound.

rig.name: Green Day - Brain Stew - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight riff definition.
Slightly boost the signal into the fuzz/amp to ensure punchy riff articulation.
Provide the core fuzzed-out, lo-fi gain required for garage punk sound.
Simulate the raw, punchy sound of a small British amp (Marshall-like edge).
Provide a classic British cabinet tone that complements the UK 45 amp model.
Slightly scoop the low-mids and boost mids to maintain riff clarity while keeping it raw.
Add a subtle sense of space and lo-fi buzz without sounding polished.
Provide a minimal amount of natural room ambience to ground the raw tone.

improvements.summary: Replace the current cabinet IR with a more aggressive, raw speaker simulation to enhance the garage punk grit.

proposals.recommendedAsset: vintage 2x12 or single-speaker IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback/Vintage)
proposals.reason: A smaller, raw speaker cabinet will better capture the lo-fi, aggressive sound of punk.
